caption: The video showcases a man in a dark patterned shirt, blue jeans and sandals seated in a homemade open-frame solar-electric vehicle. He grips a black steering wheel with red accents while the craft rolls forward along a paved road. The black tubular chassis carries a blue-tinted windshield, an overhead solar-panel canopy, red coil-over springs and a battery box behind the seat. The viewpoint drifts from a front three-quarter angle toward a rear three-quarter angle. Early frames show the driver through the reflective windshield; as the viewpoint swings to the side, the panel leaves his profile unobstructed. The same shift exposes the blue-and-red dashboard console and the full cell grid of the canopy. Background logs, a striped concrete barrier and greenery scroll past, while a blue truck streaks by mid-clip. The wheel spokes blur with rotation, and the driver stays seated with hands on the wheel, making only small head and gaze adjustments.
